about.heroTagline: Cinema, reimagined for every story worth telling — where each frame becomes a memory worth returning to.
about.story1: CV Premium began with a simple belief: a great film deserves a great room to live in. Not just a screen and a row of seats, but a space built entirely around the moment the lights go down.
about.story2: What started as a single flagship cinema grew into a nationwide chain, one city at a time — each new location built on the same obsession with picture quality, sound, and comfort that defined the first.
about.story3: We don't think of ourselves as a chain of theaters. We think of ourselves as the last mile of every story a filmmaker tells — the room where their work finally becomes an experience.
about.story4: Today, CV Premium is where audiences come not just to watch a movie, but to feel one.
about.expHeadline: Built around the moment the lights go down
about.expSeatingDesc: Wide reclining leather seats with extra legroom, individually assigned so every guest gets the same unobstructed view.
about.expScreensDesc: 4K laser projection across every hall, with IMAX and large-format screens built for scale rather than just size.
about.expSoundDesc: Object-based Dolby Atmos surround sound tuned per room, so dialogue, score and effects arrive exactly where they should.
about.ms2011Desc: CV Premium opens its flagship cinema, built around a single idea: picture and sound quality shouldn't be a premium tier — they should be the standard.
about.ms2015Desc: New locations open across the country's major cities, each one built to the same spec as the flagship rather than a scaled-down version of it.
about.ms2019Desc: Large-format screens and object-based surround sound roll out chain-wide, turning every premium hall into a genuine destination screening.
about.ms2023Desc: Reclining seating, app-based booking and a rebuilt loyalty program bring the in-cinema and online experience onto the same standard.
about.ms2026Desc: Now operating across dozens of cinemas nationwide, still measuring every new room against the one that started it all.
about.testi1Quote: The best screen in the city, hands down. I don't watch anywhere else anymore.
about.testi2Quote: Reclining seats and Dolby Atmos completely changed how I feel about going to the cinema.
about.testi3Quote: Booking is effortless and the picture quality is unreal. Every screening feels like an event.
about.ctaSub: Step into the story. Reserve your seat at the cinema built for it.
